bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const x=fs.readFileSync("/opt/videobot/owner/gateOwner.mjs","utf8");if(!x.includes("configuredVideoSaleTopic")||!x.includes("getVerifiedVideoTopic:verifyVideoTopic"))process.exit(71);console.log("VIDEO_TOPIC_RUNTIME_ADAPTER=READY")'
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "select count(*) from posting_topics where purpose='\''video_sale'\'' and chat_id=-1002373696859 and message_thread_id=1695 and enabled and verified_by is not null;"')"
test "$count" = 1 || exit 72
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/deploy
file="$root/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
test -f "$file"
orig="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
cp -p "$file" "$file.bak-video-sale-1695"
restore(){ cp -p "$file.bak-video-sale-1695" "$file"; (cd "$root" && docker compose -f "$file" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap restore EXIT
python3 - "$file" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);lines=p.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
start=next((i for i,x in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r'^  videobot-poll:\s*$',x.rstrip())),None)
if start is None: raise SystemExit('SERVICE_MISSING')
end=next((i for i in range(start+1,len(lines)) if re.match(r'^  [\w-]+:\s*$',lines[i].rstrip())),len(lines))
section=lines[start:end]
if any('VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID' in x or 'VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE' in x for x in section):raise SystemExit('CONFIG_EXISTS_RECONCILE')
env=next((i for i in range(start+1,end) if re.match(r'^    environment:\s*$',lines[i].rstrip())),None)
if env is None:raise SystemExit('ENV_BLOCK_MISSING')
nextline=next((x for x in lines[env+1:end] if x.strip() and not x.lstrip().startswith('#')),None)
if nextline is None:raise SystemExit('ENV_STYLE_UNKNOWN')
if nextline.startswith('      - '):
 addition=['      - VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID=1695\n','      - VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE=💰️稼げる有料動画投稿\n']
elif re.match(r'^      [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:',nextline):
 addition=['      VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID: "1695"\n','      VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE: "💰️稼げる有料動画投稿"\n']
else:raise SystemExit('ENV_STYLE_UNSUPPORTED')
lines[env+1:env+1]=addition
p.write_text(''.join(lines))
PY
(cd "$root" && docker compose -f "$file" config --quiet)
(cd "$root" && docker compose -f "$file" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll) >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$orig"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'if(process.env.VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID!=="1695"||!process.env.VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_TOPIC_TITLE?.includes("稼げる有料動画投稿"))process.exit(73);console.log("VIDEO_SALE_ENV_RUNTIME=PASS")'
trap - EXIT
echo VIDEO_SALE_COMPOSE_ACTIVATED=PASS
